current.text: Experts expect Neemias Queta to start at center and Robinson to come off the bench.
He is projected to play only 55 to 60 games at about 22 minutes.
Boston has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league.
He is expected to sit every back-to-back, and the heavy Boston back-to-back schedule hits him harder than most players.
Boston plays 4, 3 and 4 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21, one game short of the maximum, and has three back-to-backs in that window.
Do not spend a draft pick on him at his Yahoo ADP of 108. He is a category-league streamer, but check his back-to-backs before streaming him.
He is a good stash in formats that allow it, because he might win the starting job or Queta might get hurt.
One expert projects about 30% from the free throw line and about 6 points per game this season.

durable.text: His value comes from FG%, rebounds and blocks. His blocks have dropped off.
He is a very poor free throw shooter and one of the worst FT% impact players in the league.
He has no shooting range, makes no threes and scores very little.
He gives vertical spacing as a pick-and-roll lob threat and a dunker-spot big.
He has a history of ankle problems and missed games. His minutes are limited by his ankles and by foul trouble.

note: Robinson is a fringe pick for us. Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 178) and ESPN at 2 USD (rank 115), our league did not draft him last season, and with Queta likely starting and every back-to-back expected off, he is closer to a stream or a stash than a draft target. He only fits punt FT% builds, where his projected 70.5% FG%, 9.7 rebounds and 1.3 blocks help and his 42.5% FT% costs nothing. Early in the season, check who starts at center in Boston, his minutes (ESPN projects 25.4) and whether he really sits every back-to-back, because Boston has three of them in our playoff weeks.
